# RTX Chairman and CEO to present at the Morgan Stanley 14th Annual Laguna Conference


September 01, 2026


- Share this article on Facebook
- Share this article on Twitter
- Share this article on LinkedIn
- Share this article via email


ARLINGTON, Va.


, Sept. 1, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- RTX (NYSE: RTX) Chairman and CEO Chris Calio will speak at the Morgan Stanley 14th Annual Laguna Conference on Tuesday, Sept. 15 at 11:30 a.m. Eastern Time. The presentation will be broadcast live at[www.rtx.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4761490-1&h=4213747865&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rtx.com%2F&a=www.rtx.com) and will be archived on the website afterward.


**About RTX** With more than 180,000 global employees, we push the limits of technology and science to redefine how we connect and protect our world. With industry-leading capabilities, we advance aviation, engineer integrated defense systems for operational success, and develop next-generation technology solutions and manufacturing to help global customers address their most critical challenges. The company, with 2025 sales of more than $88 billion, is headquartered in Arlington, Virginia.


**Media Contact** C: 202.384.2474


**Investor Contact** C: 781.522.5123
